text:
Sam - Sales: Uploaded SentryBridge SIG questionnaire (CAIQ) + a couple supplemental docs to the intake bucket. Asked customer to sign but they want our security review + signature by EOW. Files: sbridg_sig_2026-03-10.pdf, sbridg_vpn_diagram.png. Link: https://redwood.share/sentrybridge/291. @elaine can you take ownership?
security-uploader-bot: File uploaded: sbridg_sig_2026-03-10.pdf (sha256: a3f5...b9d2). Virus scan: clean. Tagged: "sentrybridge/sig/2026-03".
elaine (Security): Got it — assigning to me for initial triage. I'll run the questionnaire through the intake checklist and flag gaps. ETA for gap list: tomorrow 11:00am PT. Any residency/PII notes? :white_check_mark:
Sam - Sales: Customer confirmed infra in us-west only, no BYOK. They mentioned SOC2 evidence and questions about passwordless SSO. No PHI in POC (test data only).
Mike (AE): FYI they also asked about enterprise pricing + dedicated nodes during call. That's a separate thread but might affect timeline. CC @elaine on SSO/PKI questions — they want to know if we support cert-based SSO for SAML flows.
elaine (Security): Noted. I'll include SSO/PKI as an open item. Early triage shows open items for Q5 (network segregation), Q12 (KMS/key custody), and Q28 (third-party pen test evidence).
Raj (Platform): If you need architecture artifacts or logs, I can drop the infra diagram and the vault integration doc here. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/infra/vault-integration (ping me if access is needed).
elaine (Security): @Raj please drop vault integration snippet and the control owner for KMS. Also need a copy of our public SOC2 report to share (redacted).
Mike (AE): Uploaded SOC2 link: https://redwood.docs/soc2/redwood_pub_2025.pdf — public report, controls appendix included.
elaine (Security): Perfect, thanks. I'll start drafting responses for the three open items and route to control owners for evidence collection. If everything's straightforward we can get back to Sam with a draft by EOD tomorrow; if owners need more time it might slip to Monday.
Sam - Sales: Thanks team — I'll tell the customer we'll provide a status update tomorrow EOD and flag potential Monday delivery. :eyes:
elaine (Security): Assigned owner: elaine (Security). Current status: IN_TRIAGE — collecting evidence and clarifying SSO/PKI. Action items: 1) Raj to drop vault/KMS docs, 2) Mike to confirm SOC2 link (done), 3) elaine to post gap list by tomorrow 11am PT.
Sam - Sales: Sounds good. Please @mention me in the gap list so I can coordinate follow-up with the customer. :thumbsup:
elaine (Security): Will do. Closing loop here for now — update incoming.
